messages:
sara-billing: Heads-up: customer AeroPark (AP-21) payment failed at autopay. Card declined with code 14 (invalid card number) and processor locked token.
leo-support: Customer says they updated card last week. Can you check token id and last4?
frank-payments: Token shows last4=4242, brand=VISA, status=locked_by_processor. Decline reason: invalid_number on network side. We attempted one retry; payments-bot blocked further retries.
billing-bot: Auto-retry suspended for token ap-card-21.
sara-billing: Proposal: ask customer to re-enter card in portal and offer to accept a manual ACH/wire if they need immediate coverage.
toni-sales: Customer on monthly starter plan, low churn risk. I'll ping them to update card and offer a short 24h grace if they sign authorization.
karen-legal: If offering grace > $2k get signed small addendum; otherwise note in contract. Invoice is $1,480 so verbal ok but record in notes.
leo-support: Draft message: "Hi AeroPark — your card was declined (invalid card number). Please update payment method in the billing portal or reply if you'd like wire instructions. We can apply a 24h grace while you update."
frank-payments: If they update card I will authorize a $1 test charge. Once successful, capture full amount. If they choose wire, mark invoice awaiting_wire and don't mark paid until funds settle.
billing-bot: Created internal ticket FIN-3690 to track token lock issues.
toni-sales: Customer updated card at 1823456805 and test charge authorized at 1823456812.
frank-payments: Captured full payment at 1823456820. Invoice marked PAID.
sara-billing: Closing loop. No service interruption. Noting action items: follow up on token lock root cause and monitor FIN-3690.
